description: This Java class, ConceptNameEditor, is a property editor for the ConceptName object within the OpenMRS framework. It handles serialization/deserialization to facilitate form handling and supports object retrieval by ID and UUID.

classes.name: ConceptNameEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting ConceptName objects to and from strings, enabling form handling and object retrieval by ID or UUID within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: ConceptNameEditor
methods.description: Constructor for the ConceptNameEditor class, currently empty.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a ConceptName object by its UUID string using the OpenMRS concept service.
